mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are overcast near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 72 degrees. Tonight, the temperature will drop to 59 degrees with no rain forecast. If you look to the skies at 8:19 PM, you can catch the International Space Station crossing from Mount Horeb toward the Madison area, passing almost directly overhead.
Important updates for residents include the city's ongoing election notices for the upcoming general election and the continued availability of public engineering reports through the City Council.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness and Hop Haus Trivia today. Looking ahead, Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company host live music tomorrow, and don't miss the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Main Street this Saturday.
On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Police Department began an investigation that resulted in an arrest involving a former school staff member.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Dark Chocolate Decadence. The Verona location is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM tonight.
